subject: Evidence request: deployment change stewardship & secret provenance
messages:
From: Alexa Briggs <alexa.briggs@acmeassessors.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.example.com, marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: sec-contact@finserv.example.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence needed: deployment change stewardship & secret provenance

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of the SIG/SOC2 deep-dive for FinServCo we need the following artifacts to close the SDLC section that touches change management and secrets custody:

- Deployment gating chronology for the last 12 months (who approved, timestamps, and ticket ids). Prefer CSV/JSON if possible.
- Proof of keystore rotation and KMS handoff for production (rotation events, requester, approver, KMS key IDs).
- CI/CD role bindings and the list of pipeline service accounts with access to secret stores.
- A short mapping document that ties PR/merge approvals to deployment events (2-page max).
- Any canary/rollback runbooks associated with the October 2026 incident.

Can you upload items to the secure folder I created (Drive link below) by EOD Friday (2027-03-05). If any of the artifacts are restricted we can accept a secure-scoped upload (see token link).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_secure_upload
Secure upload: https://secure-upload.redwood.example.com/token/eyJhbGci

If there are known gaps (e.g., missing operator signatures or redacted fields) please flag them in a short note so the assessor can triage.

Thanks,
Alexa Briggs
Senior Assessor, Acme Assessors
alexa.briggs@acmeassessors.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: request_manifest.txt (text)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.example.com>
To: Alexa Briggs <alexa.briggs@acmeassessors.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed: deployment change stewardship & secret provenance

Alexa — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide everything requested but a few clarifications so we give precisely what you need:

1) Deployment chronology: we have a per-environment deploy_gate_log (CSV) that ties ticket IDs (RUN-xxxx) to gate approvals. Do you prefer the raw CSV or a redacted export (names -> role mapping)?
2) KMS artifacts: we will provide the keystore_rotation_summary.docx and redacted KMS key IDs. Full key material cannot be shared; we'll provide the rotation event logs and HSM attestations.
3) CI/CD bindings: pipeline service accounts are listed in a confluence page; we'll export the bindings and include role/permission snapshots as of the last rotation (2026-11-15).
4) October incident runbooks: we will include the canary/rollback runbook and a short incident timeline.

We'll upload preliminary files to the Drive folder by end of day Thursday (2027-03-04) and follow the secure-upload for items that need restricted access.

Attachments (prepping): deploy_gate_log_2026_Q4.csv (CSV stub), keystore_rotation_summary.docx (docx stub), change_approval_manifest.pdf (PDF stub).

If you need an annotated mapping (PR -> merge -> deploy) we can produce a 2-page mapping doc; we'll aim to attach that to the final package.

Rafael Mendes
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.example.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence needed: deployment change stewardship & secret provenance — internal packaging notes

Stephanie / Rafael — quick update on packaging the pieces Alexa asked for:

- I exported deploy_gate_log_2026_Q4.csv from our gate service; it includes ticket ids and approver emails. I redacted personal emails to role@redwood.example.com (per privacy guidance) and added a "notes" column for manual approvals.
- Keystore rotation: we have rotation events for 2026-06-01, 2026-11-15, and 2027-01-09. The keystore_rotation_summary.docx summarizes requester/approver and KMS key aliases. Need Security Ops to confirm one missing operator signature on the 2026-11-15 event (ticket RUN-1142).
- CI/CD bindings export attached (confluence export) — will add a short mapping doc that ties PR numbers to merged commits and then to deployment timestamps.

Action items:
- Rafael: can you approve using the secure-upload token for the HSM attestations? Those are restricted by our KMS policy and can't go on Drive.
- Stephanie: can you check RUN-1142 with Infra to get the missing operator signature? If Infra cannot produce it, we'll add an exception note.

I attached a draft manifest (change_approval_manifest.pdf) that lists all artifacts and redaction notes.

Marissa Cole
Staff SRE, Release Engineering
marissa.cole@redwood.example.com

--
Attachments: deploy_gate_log_2026_Q4.csv (CSV stub), change_approval_manifest.pdf (PDF stub), confluence_bindings_export.html (HTML stub)

From: Alexa Briggs <alexa.briggs@acmeassessors.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.example.com, marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: sec-contact@finserv.example.com
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed: deployment change stewardship & secret provenance

Rafael / Marissa — received the preliminary package, thanks. A few quick follow-ups:

- The CSV looks good; prefer the redacted export with a role->name appendix (you can include that as a separate file).
- For the 2026-11-15 keystore rotation: we need either the missing operator signature or a signed attestation from your security ops lead documenting why the signature is absent. Can you use the secure-upload link for the HSM attestation PDF?
- Please include the short PR->merge->deploy mapping doc; the assessor will use that to spot-check three events.
- Finally, please add a 1-paragraph explanation of how ephemeral CI credentials are provisioned and rotated (bullet points; 4-5 lines is fine).

If you can get those items uploaded by EOD Monday (2027-03-08) we should be able to close the SDLC section. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alexa

--
Forwarded-attachment: keystore_rotation_summary.docx (docx stub)
